columns.name: Boot ROM
columns.hint: Fixed code inside the chip. Runs first, cannot be changed.

columns.name: First loader
columns.hint: Runs from on-chip RAM, because DRAM is not trained yet. Trains it, loads the rest.

columns.name: Secure world
columns.hint: The secure monitor (TF-A) and optionally a trusted OS (OP-TEE). Resident after boot.

columns.name: Bootloader
columns.hint: U-Boot or UEFI. Finds the kernel and device tree and starts Linux.

columns.name: Kernel
columns.hint: Linux, then the root filesystem and your application.

stages.name: Boot ROM
stages.does: Reads the boot-mode switch and loads imx-boot from 32 KiB of the SD card or eMMC.
stages.built: not built: part of the chip

stages.name: U-Boot SPL
stages.does: Identifies the module, trains the LPDDR4, unpacks the FIT image and starts BL31.
stages.stored: imx-boot.bin at 32 KiB of the card

stages.name: TF-A BL31
stages.runs: EL3 · secure monitor, resident after boot (0x0097_0000)
stages.does: Sets up TrustZone and answers PSCI calls from Linux, such as starting CPUs 1 to 3.

stages.name: OP-TEE (BL32)
stages.does: A trusted OS for keys and secure services. Optional, and not part of this build.

stages.name: U-Boot (BL33)
stages.does: Picks the device tree, loads /boot/Image.gz from the root partition and runs booti.
stages.stored: inside imx-boot.bin; reads /boot from the card

stages.name: Linux 6.18
stages.does: Starts CPUs 1 to 3 through BL31, mounts the SD card and runs /sbin/init.

stages.name: Boot ROM
stages.does: Reads the boot-mode pins, finds the GPT partition named fsbl1 and loads TF-A BL2 from it into on-chip SRAM.
stages.built: not built: part of the chip

stages.name: TF-A BL2
stages.does: Sets up the clocks, the PMIC and the DDR3 memory, programs the memory firewall and loads the FIP.

stages.name: OP-TEE
stages.does: The secure monitor (smc, PSCI), the trusted OS and the SCMI server for clocks, resets and regulators, all in one image.
stages.built: ./build.sh firmware optee, packed by firmware fip

stages.name: U-Boot
stages.does: Finds /boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf on the bootable partition and loads the kernel and device tree.
stages.stored: inside the FIP; reads /boot from the card
stages.built: ./build.sh firmware uboot, packed by firmware fip

stages.name: Linux 6.18
stages.does: Mounts the root partition by PARTUUID and runs /sbin/init. A 32-bit ARM kernel (zImage).

stages.name: Boot ROM
stages.does: Reads the boot-mode pins, finds the GPT partition named fsbla1 and loads TF-A BL2 from it into on-chip SRAM.
stages.built: not built: part of the chip

stages.name: TF-A BL2
stages.does: Trains the LPDDR4, then loads BL31, OP-TEE, U-Boot and their device trees from the FIP partition.

stages.name: TF-A BL31
stages.runs: EL3 · secure monitor, resident after boot
stages.does: Answers PSCI calls from Linux and switches between the secure and normal worlds.
stages.built: ./build.sh firmware tfa, packed by firmware fip

stages.name: OP-TEE (BL32)
stages.does: Serves SCMI requests: Linux asks it, not the registers, to set clocks, resets and voltages.
stages.built: ./build.sh firmware optee, packed by firmware fip

stages.name: U-Boot (BL33)
stages.does: Reads /boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf from the root partition and starts the kernel.
stages.stored: inside the FIP; reads /boot from the card
stages.built: ./build.sh firmware uboot, packed by firmware fip

stages.name: Linux 6.18
stages.does: Mounts the root partition by PARTUUID and runs /sbin/init. Talks to OP-TEE over SCMI.

stages.name: BootROM
stages.does: Reads the boot-mode jumper, finds BOOT.BIN in the first FAT partition of the card and copies it to on-chip RAM.
stages.built: not built: part of the chip

stages.name: U-Boot SPL (BOOT.BIN)
stages.does: Runs ps7_init (pins, PLLs, clocks and the DDR3L memory), starts the UART and the SD controller and loads u-boot.img.

stages.name: U-Boot (u-boot.img)
stages.does: Reads /extlinux/extlinux.conf, loads zImage and the device tree and runs bootz.

stages.name: Linux 6.18
stages.does: Mounts the ext4 root partition by PARTUUID and runs /sbin/init. There is no secure monitor: the Cortex-A9s stay in the secure state.
stages.stored: zImage and the DTB in the FAT partition; rootfs on partition 2

stages.name: BootROM + PSC ROM
stages.does: Initializes the boot media, loads BR-BCT, PSC-BL1, MB1 and MB1-BCT, and authenticates them.
stages.built: not built: part of the chip

stages.name: MB1
stages.runs: BPMP, the boot and power management processor
stages.does: Sets up pinmux, firewalls and SDRAM from the Memory BCT, loads the firmware that starts the CPU complex, then loads MB2.

stages.name: MB2
stages.does: The next-stage bootloader; also the stage that receives binaries from the host during flashing.

stages.name: TF-A + OP-TEE
stages.runs: secure world on the CPU complex
stages.does: The secure monitor and trusted OS, packaged as one image (tos-optee_t234.img) that sits beside UEFI in the secure-os partition.

stages.name: UEFI + L4TLauncher
stages.does: UEFI applies device-tree overlays and picks the boot device; L4TLauncher then reads extlinux.conf and loads the kernel, initrd and device tree.
stages.stored: UEFI in QSPI-NOR; L4TLauncher on the EFI system partition

stages.name: Linux 5.15 (tegra)
stages.does: Mounts the root filesystem from SD or NVMe and starts systemd, with NVIDIA's userland on top.
